species.name: Green turtle
species.rangeSummary: NOAA describes a broad distribution across the Atlantic, Pacific and Indian oceans and the Mediterranean Sea.
species.habitat: Young turtles develop offshore; older juveniles and adults forage in shallow coastal waters, including seagrass and algae habitats.
species.citation: Uetz, P. (ed.) (2026). The Reptile Database. Chelonia mydas (Linnaeus, 1758). Accessed through: World Register of Marine Species at: https://www.marinespecies.org/aphia.php?p=taxdetails&id=137206 on 2026-11-21
species.associationBasis: Broad NOAA range context; not a sighting or confirmed local occurrence.

species.name: Hawksbill turtle
species.rangeSummary: NOAA describes nearshore habitats across the world's major oceans.
species.habitat: Older turtles commonly forage on coral reefs; some use mangrove estuaries. Hatchlings spend their early years offshore around floating algae and drift material.
species.citation: Uetz, P. (ed.) (2026). The Reptile Database. Eretmochelys imbricata (Linnaeus, 1766). Accessed through: World Register of Marine Species at: https://www.marinespecies.org/aphia.php?p=taxdetails&id=137207 on 2026-11-21
species.associationBasis: Broad NOAA range context; not a sighting or confirmed local occurrence.

species.name: Leatherback turtle
species.rangeSummary: NOAA describes leatherbacks across the Atlantic, Pacific and Indian oceans, migrating between distant feeding and nesting regions.
species.habitat: These ocean-going turtles feed on soft-bodied prey such as jellyfish and salps; females come ashore on warm-water nesting beaches.
species.citation: Uetz, P. (ed.) (2026). The Reptile Database. Dermochelys coriacea (Vandelli, 1761). Accessed through: World Register of Marine Species at: https://www.marinespecies.org/aphia.php?p=taxdetails&id=137209 on 2026-11-21
species.associationBasis: Broad NOAA range context; not a sighting or confirmed local occurrence.

species.name: Yellowfin tuna
species.rangeSummary: NOAA describes yellowfin in tropical and subtropical oceans worldwide, including the Caribbean and Pacific.
species.habitat: Highly migratory fish of warm ocean waters. Larvae and juveniles occupy surface waters; older fish also use deeper water and may gather around floating objects.
